name: Reliquary of Truth
effectTemplate: CRIT Rate is increased by <color=#99FFFFFF>{0}</color>. When the equipping character unleashes an Elemental Skill, they gain the Secret of Lies effect: Elemental Mastery is increased by <color=#99FFFFFF>{1}</color> for 12s. When the equipping character deals Lunar-Bloom DMG to an opponent, they gain the Moon of Truth effect: CRIT DMG is increased by <color=#99FFFFFF>{2}</color> for 4s. When both the Secret of Lies and Moon of Truth effects are active at the same time, the results of both effects will be increased by 50%.
